content.enriched_brief: Make a contemporary high-school sweet-and-bitter romance animated short drama. The high-school female lead is a student, depicted wearing a dark blue school uniform and white socks, carrying a shoulder bag. Rumor says she is the secret daughter of the largest private-academy benefactor in northern Jiangbei. On her very first day as a transfer student, she clashes head-on with the school's most untouchable bully. Add a light-yet-bittersweet piano BGM.
